purpose: Expanded full-body combat and isolated own-limb rendering in both player views.
source: Authored public CMU mocap, not live camera input or autonomous gameplay.

video.encoding: Actual three-canvas browser recording, H.264 CRF 18, variable frame rate, no interpolated frames. Encoding/capture throughput is not live rendering FPS.

main_view_isolation.method: Same paused frame and main-canvas crop, toggle own-limb rendering only; RGB pixel difference. This proves this representative frame, not every possible configuration.

leg_screening.limit: Geometric screening only, not a naturalness rating or independent ground truth.

performance.limit: Short three-window browser measurement, not three Full-HD monitors, sustained 60 FPS or end-to-end camera latency.

known_limits: Captured full-body motion with authored timing, root adjustment, inertial joins and IK; not dynamic muscle or balance simulation.
Some transition foot slide, pose stiffness and limited hit reactions remain.
Side-kick recognition has missed and knee-confused events in later source repetitions; spin and combinations are not validated real-time recognition classes.
Own limbs use a view-only translation and 68-degree FOV in full-opponent mode; physical-eye experiment uses unchanged world pose and its actual projection.
Close-up hands expose existing model skinning and finger-prior limitations; shoulder/hip fades reduce hard cuts but extreme turns can still look detached.
Extreme kicks can still intersect the skirt waist; no claim of clothing collision completion.
No Gemini camera, Unity Editor or real multi-monitor hardware validation in this review.
